activity_status.bny_custody: BNY states it now supports XRP and RLUSD custody for eligible institutional clients. No balances, client counts or transfer volumes disclosed.
activity_status.bny_rlusd_mint_redeem: Intended future functionality; subject to final BNY and regulatory approvals.
activity_status.ripple_national_trust_bank: OCC CAS records Consummated/Effective 2026-10-26. Ripple says the bank will provide RLUSD reserve management, collateral trustee and fiduciary custody; the release says it is beginning operations, but live client balances and service throughput are not disclosed.
activity_status.circle_national_trust_bank: OCC CAS records Consummated/Effective 2026-07-24. The bank's initial OCC scope supports USDC reserve management, collateral trusteeship and affiliate custody; operational balances are not disclosed.
activity_status.c2fo_instant_pay: Waitlist and limited rollout; capital-provider names and actual funded invoice/settlement volumes not disclosed.
activity_status.coinbase_rlusd: Live on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail with XRPL, Base and Ethereum support. RLUSD collateral for Coinbase Global Exchange customers is a future rollout, not live at announcement.
activity_status.coinbase_derivatives: Ripple Prime client access to Coinbase Derivatives contracts, including XRP futures, through Nodal Clear is announced. Actual client utilization and contract-level volume attributable to Ripple Prime are unknown.

hypotheses.name: Institutional custody access increases XRP's investability and operational availability
support: BNY supports XRP custody for eligible institutions
Ripple Prime and Coinbase Derivatives provide regulated XRP futures access
disconfirming_or_limiting: No BNY XRP balances or client volumes disclosed
Futures access is not spot ownership
No evidence of net new spot buying attributable to the relationships

hypotheses.name: RLUSD distribution and payments increase XRPL activity but do not automatically create material XRP demand
support: RLUSD is supported on XRPL and Coinbase
C2FO Instant Pay plans RLUSD settlement on XRPL
BNY supports RLUSD custody and Ripple says RLUSD is used as Ripple Prime collateral
disconfirming_or_limiting: RLUSD, not XRP, is the stated settlement/collateral asset in these use cases
No XRPL fee, bridge-liquidity or XRP inventory volume attributable to the use cases is disclosed

hypotheses.name: Coinbase is positioning as a multi-stablecoin distribution and institutional access venue
support: Coinbase Prime, exchange, retail, derivatives and FCM stack
disconfirming_or_limiting: No revenue-share or volume data for RLUSD listing
No evidence that USDC share is being displaced

hypotheses.name: Ripple Prime and Coinbase Derivatives have a cooperative clearing/distribution relationship while competing in other product areas
support: Ripple Prime clients access Coinbase Derivatives through Nodal Clear
Both FCMs are Nodal Clear members
disconfirming_or_limiting: No bilateral ownership or exclusive agreement
No client-level usage or revenue data

confirmed: BNY supports XRP custody for eligible institutional clients.
Coinbase Derivatives lists XRP futures and Ripple Prime clients can access the suite through Nodal Clear.
RLUSD can be moved on XRPL through Coinbase's distribution partnership.
not_confirmed: XRP is a required reserve asset of Ripple National Trust Bank.
XRP is the settlement asset in C2FO Instant Pay.
XRP is used as collateral in the new BNY/Ripple or Coinbase RLUSD integrations.
Any material net spot XRP purchases resulting from the relationships.
Any specific amount of XRP held by BNY, Ripple Prime, Coinbase or institutional clients through these arrangements.

next_actions: Request or locate BNY digital-asset custody disclosures with asset-level balances or transfer volume.
Monitor Ripple Prime for RLUSD collateral eligibility, haircut, outstanding collateral and client utilization data.
Monitor C2FO Instant Pay for named funding providers, first funded invoices and XRPL transaction volume.
Monitor Coinbase Global Exchange for actual RLUSD collateral activation and subsequent use.
Track Coinbase Derivatives XRP futures open interest and volume, and compare with Nodal Clear clearing data when public.
Separate XRP custody, XRP futures, RLUSD collateral and RLUSD settlement as distinct demand channels.
